principle: KGPV defines the desired experience. HPC and established Airtable tables define canonical intelligence. Do not migrate golden-demo fixtures without independent verification.

kgpvGoldenDemoFieldCoverage.note: KGPV UI population = desired experience depth. NOT verified Airtable coverage.

integrationWork.summary: Stop mislabeling HPC reads as Hotel Census; resolve owning table via RECORD_ID() and set censusSourceTable correctly.

For HPC-owned hotels (Bethesda), use formatHotelPropertyCensusAsBrandPresenceHotel (or equivalent) so Overview provenance is true HPC — and backfill empty HPC fields that UI currently invents via Brand Family / enrichment.
Connect Organization + Relationships tabs to he-airtable-graph reader so Operator/Brand orgs and edges reach gold-depth UI without fixtures.
Build portfolio_kpis / operated_managed_hotels / structure_chart from HI Rel queries once org is linked.
Wire Contacts fallback_paths from HPC Phone + Official Property URL before paid person enrichment.
Unify KGPV onto HPC (or approved link strategy) before any golden-demo → Airtable migration. Fixtures stay UX reference only until independently verified.

researchPrioritiesAfterIntegration.action: Confirm CURRENT Bethesda economic owner (free SDAT/filings first; paid only if blocked). Do not use 2013 Northview/Oaktree as current claim.
After economic owner — PropCo/UBO if still missing.
Decision-maker contacts only after owner known; public paths before paid.
No paid research / no fixture migration until HPC identity unification + independent fact verification.
